categories.main_business_segments: Kunshan Dongwei Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in high-end precision electroplating equipment manufacturing, focusing on three main sectors: PCB electroplating equipment, general hardware surface treatment equipment, and new energy electroplating equipment. The company offers vertical continuous plating equipment, horizontal plating equipment, and specialized equipment for lithium batteries and photovoltaic cells. It also provides related accessories, maintenance, and technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology centers on vertical continuous plating (VCP) technology, including patented steel belt transmission systems that improve plating uniformity and equipment lifespan. It employs advanced electrochemical etching, automated and intelligent manufacturing processes, and modular segmented production techniques. The firm also develops innovative horizontal wet process equipment and vacuum sputtering technologies for composite copper and aluminum foils used in lithium batteries and photovoltaics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic PCB manufacturers, new energy battery producers, photovoltaic cell manufacturers, and general hardware manufacturers in sectors such as automotive, aerospace, 5G communications, AI, cloud storage, and consumer electronics. The company serves both first-tier domestic clients and international customers in Europe, Southeast Asia, North America, Japan, Korea, and Taiwan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Kunshan, Guangdong (Shenzhen and Dongguan), Anhui (Guangde), and Jiangsu (Changshu). It has expanded overseas with a production base in Thailand serving Southeast Asian markets. Its sales and service network covers domestic and international markets including Europe, North America, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongwei Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electroplating equipment supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of electroplating machinery and related technical services. It sources raw materials and components from upstream suppliers but does not engage in raw material extraction or downstream PCB or battery manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on innovation in vertical continuous plating technology, horizontal wet process equipment, and new energy applications such as lithium battery composite foil plating and photovoltaic copper plating. It emphasizes developing proprietary technologies, expanding product lines, and enhancing automation, environmental sustainability, and energy efficiency. Collaboration with universities and research institutes supports its innovation pipeline.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized electroplating equipment and related accessories, installation and commissioning services, and after-sales maintenance. The company mainly uses direct sales to end customers, supplemented by limited distribution channels. It also earns income from government subsidies and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dongwei Technology is a leading domestic player with over 50% market share in China’s vertical continuous plating equipment for PCB manufacturing. It competes with foreign and regional companies such as Amtech (Germany), Jingming Machinery (Taiwan), and other Hong Kong and Taiwanese firms. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, scale production, and expanding into new energy sectors where it holds a global first-mover advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 750 million, a 17.5% decline from the previous year, mainly due to reduced demand in the new energy sector. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 69.3 million, down 54.25%. Total assets grew 9.5% to RMB 2.72 billion, with net assets stable at around RMB 1.73 billion. R&D expenses increased to 11% of revenue, reflecting ongoing innovation efforts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dongwei Technology offers high-performance, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly electroplating solutions with superior plating uniformity and reliability. Its patented steel belt transmission and vertical continuous plating technologies reduce maintenance costs and improve product quality. The company’s unique position as the only global mass producer of new energy lithium battery plating equipment and its advanced copper plating solutions for photovoltaics provide significant competitive advantages.
